claims.live_value: Minimalist Greek-inspired grill steps from Padang Padang — wood fire, natural wine and the Bukit's most confident new dinner room.
claims.quote: A modern Greek-inspired grill, where hospitality leads, wood-fired cooking happens, and memorable gatherings come naturally
claims.note: 'the Bukit's most confident new dinner room' is quality language (Q) — removal candidate. Supported parts: Greek-inspired grill, wood fire (home.jsx marquee 'Wood-Fire Grill'), 'Natural Wine'. 'steps from Padang Padang' and 'dinner room' are not on the official site (site says 12 PM open, 'Long lunches'). Suggest rewrite without superlative. official site is a client-rendered React SPA: the visible text lives in the stored .jsx file (saved as .bin, no textFile), so validate-claims cannot check the quote automatically; acceptor/founder must open the stored file
